verdict.rationale: Adyen's official MCP server, which an agent can drive, includes tools to create, get and expire payment links, so an agent can create a payment link via the API in a session. The evidence shows no API for creating standalone product or price catalog objects. The Product Feed API is a different capability: it syncs inventory to AI shopping platforms and does not provision billing products or prices. missing for 10: API to create product objects, API to create reusable price objects, documented end-to-end agent flow chaining product→price→link, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent provision a new product, price, and payment link via the API in a single session

citations.quote: Our Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets you use natural language with your chosen Large Language Model (LLM) client.
